title: Army minstrel shows and the 25th Engineers
summary: He describes touring camps with an army minstrel show, being hit by thrown coins in France, and his cornet in Company A, 25th Engineers.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: yes did you ever play any instrument in a grass band? in the army I did
that's right you did have the well you might tell us a little bit about that army band we forgot about that how you taught Jim Robinson he's told us a little bit about that

well we used to go and from one we had a convoy one of the captains out of company B take us out I can't call the places but we'd be out sometime for ten days going from one camp to another and twenty eight soldiers of the companies different companies minstrel and they used to put on shows you know they had some playing women putting dresses on and everything and one place we played down there he my brother he's dead now he was singing the blues on the stage he called him John Chandler and I was still playing I know something struck my head but used to pick up three and four hats of those sous throwing up I was down in the pit in one of those theaters playing and there was a crowd of the soldiers they were throwing money I got cut to my head and I thought I was first and the captain he looked behind the curtain on the corner he'd run down there he says get up William J that's where I was coming come here quick I said something happened to you I said I got cut up there playing the blues in France they were throwing money so like that yeah that could hurt you
half a dollar a quarter or something like that
yes I didn't know what it was but I know it was one of them big sous they were almost bigger than half a dollar yeah
that size could really hurt you

it was heavy too we'd go on our tour and then go back to camp and we used to play moving pitches up at headquarters play for moving pitches at midnight they had all that that's what after the war then you know that's where the music soldiers had baseball teams
